get.description: Redirects to the creative's stored target URL, or to the portal's home page for an unknown or inactive creative. Anonymous.
Retrieves the tenant's banner placement assignments using OData query options.

post.description: Assigns a banner set to a placement key on one portal, or on every portal when no portal is given. One assignment per key and portal scope.

get.description: Returns the count of the tenant's banner placement assignments using OData query options.

get.summary: Get banner placement assignment by ID
get.description: Retrieves one of the tenant's banner placement assignments by its ID.

put.description: Points the assignment at another banner set of the tenant with a new priority. The key and portal are not editable.

delete.description: Deletes one of the tenant's banner placement assignments.

get.description: Returns the placement-key catalog: each key with its display name, binding aspect ratio and recommended upload size.

get.summary: Get the banners of a placement
get.description: Returns up to 'count' (1 to 4) banners for a placement key on a portal, sampled by weight and localized for 'culture'. Anonymous; no-store.

post.description: Creates a banner set for the specified tenant.

get.description: Returns the count of the tenant's banner sets using OData query options.

put.description: Replaces the editable fields of one of the tenant's banner sets.

delete.description: Deletes one of the tenant's banner sets with its creatives, and the placement assignments that point at it. Daily counts are kept.

get.description: Returns the daily counts (served in page renders, recorded clicks) of the set's creatives for UTC days from 'from' to 'to'. A missing day is unavailable, not zero.

put.description: Replaces every field of a creative; its localizations become exactly the list given.

delete.description: Removes a creative and its localizations from one of the tenant's banner sets. Its daily counts are kept.
